name: blog-brand
description: Establish durable brand and voice context for cross-skill consumption. Generates BRAND.md (audience, positioning, do/don't editorial rules, taboo phrases, competitor differentiation) and VOICE.md (existing persona JSON re-expressed as readable prose), both written to the project root. When present, the blog orchestrator loads these files, fenced as untrusted data, for write, rewrite, brief, outline, calendar, and strategy workflows. Pairs with blog-persona, which manages the structured persona JSON. Use when the user says "blog brand", "create brand context", "BRAND.md", "VOICE.md", "establish editorial brand". Not for learning a voice from existing posts (blog-style) or managing persona JSON (blog-persona).
